thread:
Anya (CS): quick weekly check-in for Mosslane on caching + batching effectiveness. TL;DR: hit rate dropped, cost up. Can we sync?
Mike - Solutions: thanks — putting numbers here from last 7d: hit_rate=42% (-5ppt wk), avg_batch_size=3.4 (stable), cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.85 (+12%), p95_latency=220ms (+30ms).
Rohan (Eng): thanks Anya. Do we know if the hit-rate drop correlates to a recent model rollout or prompt change?
Anya (CS): not that I can see — tenant pinned model v1.3.0. Onboarding traffic increased new prefixes last Tue. I suspect TTLs for prefix cache are expiring more often.
Sofia (Acct): Mosslane flagged rising bill last week — they asked if we can reduce spend without hurting latency.
Mike - Solutions: ok itemize options: 1) bump prefix TTL from 5m -> 15m for high-read routes; 2) increase max_batch_window from 25ms -> 50ms for background jobs; 3) enable lightweight quantized variant for lower-cost tier. Thoughts on risk?
Rohan (Eng): risk on (1) is staleness for dynamic completions — needs dataset-level guard. (2) should be fine for non-interactive routes; test with canary. (3) quantized variant drops quality for long-form, need prompt-based evals.
Anya (CS): proposed canary plan: 24h on 10% sessions for routes: /summarize and /autocomplete-bg. Metrics to watch: hit_rate, avg_batch_size, p95_latency, user-facing error_rate.
Mike - Solutions: I'll take owner for canary. Can we get a quick cost delta estimate? Quick calc: current tokens/day ~ 12M. If hit rate improves +8ppt and avg_batch_size +0.6, back-of-envelope cost reduction ~ 9-11%.
Rohan (Eng): small calc I ran in console: ```
# simple estimate
base_cost_per_1k = 0.85
current_tokens_k = 12000
improved_hit = 0.50
reduction_pct = (improved_hit - 0.42) * 0.6  # conservative
estimated_savings_pct = f"{reduction_pct*100:.1f}%"
print(estimated_savings_pct)
```
(we should run against actual token logs but gives a sense)
Sofia (Acct): can you put projected savings in Mosslane renewal deck? even a 7-10% saving helps.
Anya (CS): will add to deck. Mike — can you start the canary today? Rohan please add the canary toggles and a quick telemetry dashboard (per-route hit rate + batch size).
Mike - Solutions: starting now. toggles: `prefix_ttl_override` and `batch_window_ms` will be in the feature flag. rolling to 10% in 15m. cc @cs-automation for alerting. :rocket:
cs-automation: Canary started for Mosslane: 10% sessions, routes [/summarize, /autocomplete-bg]. Alerts: hit_rate_drop > 4ppt OR p95_latency > 300ms.
Rohan (Eng): added dashboard panels under Ops -> Mosslane -> CacheBatch. Also added a quick loglink for failed requests.
Anya (CS): great. follow-ups: Mike update at +2h and +24h; Rohan put expected metric baselines in the dashboard annotations. Sofia — I'll draft the renewal note.
Sofia (Acct): thanks — ping me once we have 24h numbers.
Mike - Solutions: 2h check-in: initial uplift visible — hit_rate ~47%, avg_batch_size=3.9, p95_latency=230ms. cost-per-1k trending down. will post 24h summary.
Anya (CS): noted. closing provisional action items here. If anyone sees regressions tag channel. :thumbsup:
